title: The Lion and the Mouse
moral: Even someone small can help a big friend.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, new 만 새로 녹음한다(trim 없음). 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

lines.text: 나무 그늘에서 사자가 쿨쿨 낮잠을 자요.
lines.en: The lion is taking a nap in the shade of a tree. Zzz!
segs: The lion is taking a nap in the shade of a tree. Zzz!

lines.text: 쿨쿨, 드르렁! 사자 코 고는 소리가 풀밭에 울렸어요.
lines.en: Zzz, snore! The sound of the lion snoring rolled across the meadow.
segs: Zzz, snore! The sound of the lion snoring rolled across the meadow.

lines.text: 코에서 콧방울이 푸우, 푸우, 커졌다 작아졌다 해요.
lines.en: A bubble on his nose went puff, puff, growing big and then small again.
segs: A bubble on his nose went puff, puff, growing big and then small again.

lines.text: 콧방울이 퐁! 그래도 사자는 쿨쿨 자요.
lines.en: The nose bubble goes pop! But the lion keeps on sleeping.
segs: The nose bubble goes pop! But the lion keeps on sleeping.

lines.text: 사자 갈기가 바람에 살랑살랑 흔들렸어요.
lines.en: The lion's mane swayed softly in the breeze, swish, swish.
segs: The lion's mane swayed softly in the breeze, swish, swish.

lines.text: 작은 생쥐가 산책을 나왔어요. 풀이 숲처럼 커다래요!
lines.en: A little mouse comes out for a walk. The grass is as big as a forest!
segs: A little mouse comes out for a walk. The grass is as big as a forest!

lines.text: 폴짝폴짝, 생쥐는 풀 사이를 신나게 뛰어다녔어요.
lines.en: Hop, hop, hop! The little mouse bounced happily through the tall grass.
segs: Hop, hop, hop! The little mouse bounced happily through the tall grass.

lines.text: 어? 이건 뭐지? 폴짝!
lines.en: Huh? What's this? Hop!

lines.text: 와아! 사자 갈기는 커다란 미끄럼틀이었어요. 쭈르륵~ 히히!
lines.en: Wheee! The lion's mane was a great big slide. Whoosh! Hee hee!
segs: The lion's mane was a great big slide.

lines.text: 어? 사자가 눈을 떴어요!
lines.en: Oh? The lion's eyes are open!
segs: Oh? The lion's eyes are open!

lines.text: 사자가 커다란 앞발로 생쥐 꼬리를 탁! 눌렀어요.
lines.en: The lion pressed the mouse's tail with a big paw. Thump!
segs: The lion pressed the mouse's tail with a big paw. Thump!

lines.text: 사자가 하품하며 말했어요. "하암~ 한입에 꿀꺽 해 버릴까?"
lines.en: The lion yawned and said, "Haaah... shall I gobble you up in one bite?"
segs: "Haaah... shall I gobble you up in one bite?"

lines.text: 생쥐가 말했어요. "살려 주시면 꼭 은혜 갚을게요!"
lines.en: The mouse said, "If you let me go, I promise I'll pay you back!"
segs: "If you let me go, I promise I'll pay you back!"

lines.text: 생쥐는 덜덜 떨면서도 또박또박 말했어요.
lines.en: The mouse was shaking like a leaf, but he spoke up loud and clear.
segs: The mouse was shaking like a leaf, but he spoke up loud and clear.

lines.text: 생쥐가 두 손을 모았어요. "제발요, 사자님~"
lines.en: The mouse put both hands together. "Please, Lion, please!"
segs: The mouse put both hands together.

lines.text: "저는 작지만 이빨이 아주 튼튼하다고요!"
lines.en: I may be small, but my teeth are very, very strong!
segs: I may be small, but my teeth are very, very strong!

lines.text: "네가? 나를 도와준다고?"
lines.en: "You? You'll help me?"

lines.text: 사자는 배를 잡고 껄껄, 땅이 쿵쿵 울리도록 웃었어요.
lines.en: The lion held his belly and roared with laughter, ho, ho, ho, until the ground shook.
segs: The lion held his belly and roared with laughter, ho, ho, ho, until the ground shook.

lines.text: 사자가 웃다가 앞발이 스르르 열렸어요.
lines.en: The lion laughed, and the big paw slowly opened.
segs: The lion laughed, and the big paw slowly opened.

lines.text: 생쥐가 쏙 빠져나왔어요. "고맙습니다, 사자님!"
lines.en: The mouse slipped right out. "Thank you, Lion!"

lines.text: 생쥐는 꼬리를 흔들며 다다다, 풀숲으로 달려갔어요.
lines.en: The mouse waved his tail and scurried off into the grass, pitter-patter, pitter-patter.
segs: The mouse waved his tail and scurried off into the grass, pitter-patter, pitter-patter.

lines.text: 사자 발가락 하나가 생쥐 한 마리만 해요!
lines.en: One lion toe is as big as a whole mouse!
segs: One lion toe is as big as a whole mouse!

lines.text: 사자 발자국은 쿵쿵 커다랗고, 생쥐 발자국은 콩콩 조그마해요.
lines.en: The lion's footprints are great big thumps, and the mouse's footprints are teeny tiny taps.
segs: The lion's footprints are great big thumps, and the mouse's footprints are teeny tiny taps.

lines.text: 생쥐 이빨은 작지만 아주 튼튼해요. 사각사각 뭐든 갉을 수 있지요.
lines.en: The mouse's teeth are small, but very strong. Nibble, nibble! They can gnaw anything.
segs: The mouse's teeth are small, but very strong. Nibble, nibble! They can gnaw anything.

lines.text: 크면 큰 대로, 작으면 작은 대로 다 쓸모가 있어요.
lines.en: Big or small, everyone is useful.
segs: Big or small, everyone is useful.

lines.text: 밤이 되었어요. 앗, 사자가 그물에 걸렸어요!
lines.en: Night came. Oh no, the lion is caught in a net!
segs: Night came. Oh no, the lion is caught in a net!

lines.text: 사자가 버둥버둥, 그래도 그물이 풀리지 않아요.
lines.en: The lion wiggles and wriggles, but the net won't come loose.
segs: The lion wiggles and wriggles, but the net won't come loose.

lines.text: 그물은 꽁꽁, 사자는 꼼짝달싹할 수 없었어요.
lines.en: The net was tied up tight, and the lion could not move an inch.
segs: The net was tied up tight, and the lion could not move an inch.

lines.text: 어흥, 어흥! 사자가 슬픈 목소리로 크게 울었어요.
lines.en: Roar, roar! The lion cried out in a sad, loud voice.
segs: Roar, roar! The lion cried out in a sad, loud voice.

lines.text: 쫑긋! 생쥐가 사자 목소리를 들었어요.
lines.en: Ears up! The mouse heard the lion's voice.
segs: Ears up! The mouse heard the lion's voice.

lines.text: "사자님, 제가 도와 드릴게요!"
lines.en: "Lion, I'll help you!"

lines.text: 생쥐가 작은 이빨로 그물을 갉아요. 사각사각, 한 줄씩 끊어요!
lines.en: The mouse gnaws the net with tiny teeth. Nibble, nibble, one rope at a time!
segs: The mouse gnaws the net with tiny teeth. Nibble, nibble, one rope at a time!

lines.text: 사각사각, 사각사각. 그물 줄이 하나씩 툭, 툭 끊어졌어요.
lines.en: Nibble, nibble, nibble, nibble. One by one, the ropes went snap, snap.
segs: Nibble, nibble, nibble, nibble. One by one, the ropes went snap, snap.

lines.text: 하나, 둘, 셋… 열! 그물 줄 열 개를 다 끊었어요!
lines.en: One, two, three... ten! All ten ropes are cut!
segs: One, two, three... ten! All ten ropes are cut!

lines.text: 마지막 줄이 툭! 끊어지자 그물이 스르르 풀렸어요.
lines.en: Snap! went the last rope, and the net slid loose, sliiide.
segs: Snap! went the last rope, and the net slid loose, sliiide.

lines.text: 와아! 사자가 풀려났어요!
lines.en: Hooray! The lion is free!

lines.text: "고마워, 작은 친구. 작은 이빨이 나를 구해 줬구나!"
lines.en: "Thank you, little friend. Your tiny teeth saved me!"
segs: "Thank you, little friend. Your tiny teeth saved me!"

lines.text: "제가 은혜 갚는다고 했지요?"
lines.en: "Didn't I say I'd pay you back?"
segs: "Didn't I say I'd pay you back?"

lines.text: 다음 날 아침, 사자가 생쥐를 등에 태웠어요. "꽉 잡아!"
lines.en: The next morning, the lion put the mouse on its back. "Hold tight!"
segs: The next morning, the lion put the mouse on its back.

lines.text: 다다다! 사자가 바람처럼 달리고, 생쥐는 갈기를 꼭 붙잡았어요.
lines.en: Thump, thump, thump! The lion ran like the wind, and the mouse held on tight to his mane.
segs: Thump, thump, thump! The lion ran like the wind, and the mouse held on tight to his mane.

lines.text: 바람을 가르며 초원을 달려요! 신난다!
lines.en: They race across the meadow through the wind! Yippee!
segs: They race across the meadow through the wind!

lines.text: 둘은 깔깔, 하하 웃으며 초원을 한 바퀴 빙 돌았어요.
lines.en: They giggled and laughed, tee-hee, ha-ha, as they ran one big loop around the meadow.
segs: They giggled and laughed, tee-hee, ha-ha, as they ran one big loop around the meadow.

lines.text: 그날부터 사자와 생쥐는 둘도 없는 친구가 되었답니다.
lines.en: From that day on, the lion and the mouse were the best of friends.
segs: From that day on, the lion and the mouse were the best of friends.

lines.text: 작아도 큰 친구를 도울 수 있답니다.
lines.en: Even someone small can help a big friend.
segs: Even someone small can help a big friend.
